reviews.title: Not bad, could be better
reviews.text: This game is honestly pretty fun, I’ve played loads of it. It gives you decent rewards, but my biggest issue with this game is how many ads there are. There is an option to buy skip ad tokens, but no option to pay to permanently remove them. This game is practically unplayable to me unless I can skip the ads, so I end up avoiding it to not spend money. Most of the items in the game to progress are pretty expensive in game currency as well and it can feel like a grind at times where you are stuck on a level playing the side challenges over and over or considering buying your way through. That being said I do think this game has some charm and can be rather addictive. It’s also pretty surface level, I give 0 craps and don’t really feel any interest in the small stories or interactions they add in between each scene or for any of the characters. Although I don’t think this game was really going for depth. It’s fun for what it is, but the micro transactions CONSTANTLY being shoved in your face and ads are insanely annoying. The skip ad tokens are also sometimes automatically used when claiming rewards to double them without asking. There’s promise to this game but also a lot of room for improvement.

reviews.title: Was amazing

I truly love the game however I have entered a part where it is almost impossible to finish the mission because the amount of points for the mission is almost impossible! I’ve been saving for 10 days and still don’t have enough and if I was to pay real money to pass the level it would cost 49.99! YES $49.99! So beware that this game is fun but I noticed with the last update the missions are harder and expect way higher points to pass even with one star! It used to be fun because as long as you played all day you could enjoy the challenges and the quests to get items and super cool rewards but they make it so hard once you reach a certain level, you just can’t get any of the rewards from the challenges because it takes well over a week to save up to level up a item to the highest level, then the contests are over! I’m not spending another dime on this game because I spent well over $100.00 cash real money and when I lost my diamonds to a glitch customer service basically told me “too bad”! I LOVE THE GAME! But I fear I may have to delete it since I can’t seem to get past this mission!Really sad after 10 days I can’t complete this mission! Every update this game gets harder, less rewards and more money wanted for anything. It’s frustrating.

I love this game. I realized I feel like a grown up playing with barbies again, which is very wholesome. 
In the past years, I’ve heard black women talk about how hard it is to find flattering makeup for them because most of them have some white cast, and the shades are just not made with them in mind. I am not black, but I have noticed that the specifically the blushes and lipsticks that I can put on the black models without them looking crazy (with a weird white cast beneath it) is very limited. I’ve also noticed that the hair textures are very limited. It would be amazing to see more curly/afro hair. I would love to see the app bring more of these features so it becomes a space where we can all feel beautiful and included❤️

reviews.title: Good at first, but not sustainable.
reviews.text: This game is lots of fun at first when you’re in the earlier levels. It is fun to design outfits and compete with other people , as well as complete challenges that earn you coins and diamonds needed for smaller games and missions . But as you get to later levels it’s impossible to beat levels without ridiculous amount of very expensive upgrades, and most of the missions don’t earn you enough to do these upgrades so you likely have to exchange your few diamonds for more coins just to upgrade a very specific item that is needed. I’m not opposed to paying for game rewards on occasion , but the dollar conversions are not even worth it.   There’s no reason a pack of virtual hairstyle should be over $10 , even five dollars would be pushing it . I’ve been stuck on a mission for days because I need to upgrade dress  for 75000 coins. Some of the side battles are fun, but the amount of bots in the games just ruin it . I really want to continue to enjoy this game, but I do see myself throwing the towel eventually.

reviews.title: Cute game but way too many ads with low rewards
reviews.text:
This game is cute and fun if you love fashion. It’s definitely a nice little game to escape in when winding down from work. My complaints about this app is that the rewards are extremely low for all the ad watching you have to do. There is no option to just simply pay a cost for a month to not see ads and simply enjoy the game. Also when the app freezes you will not earn any rewards you were expecting after watching an ad for the 50th time. 

I play this game with my niece because she loves fashion as well. I love that you can also do interior design of a spaces. Now after you play the contest and placed 1st, 2nd or 3rd and place in several contests do not expect to win the amount they initially show you. It’s always less than what it shows. It’s significantly less actually. So that is another disappointing and frustrating experience with this game. I would continue to play but I think I’ll stick to my other games. I only gave it a 3 because I love the fashion and spaces within the game.
